title: Bridging the Unavoidable A Priori: A Framework for Comparative Causal Modeling
reasoning: The paper proposes a mathematical framework to unify System Dynamics (SD) and Structural Equation Modeling (SEM) for causal analysis in AI/ML contexts. While it discusses 'responsible AI' and the 'epistemology' of modeling assumptions, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics.
